accounts_last_four_format_check.name: accounts_last_four_format_check
accounts_last_four_format_check.value: "accounts"."last_four" IS NULL OR ("accounts"."kind" = 'rdsp' AND "accounts"."last_four" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]{4}$') OR ("accounts"."kind" <> 'rdsp' AND "accounts"."last_four" ~ '^[0-9]{4}$')

household_expenses_date_order_check.name: household_expenses_date_order_check
household_expenses_date_order_check.value: "household_expenses"."ends_on" IS NULL OR "household_expenses"."starts_on" IS NULL OR "household_expenses"."ends_on" >= "household_expenses"."starts_on"

import_batches_completion_order_check.name: import_batches_completion_order_check
import_batches_completion_order_check.value: ("import_batches"."completed_at" IS NULL OR "import_batches"."completed_at" >= "import_batches"."started_at") AND ("import_batches"."accepted_at" IS NULL OR "import_batches"."accepted_at" >= "import_batches"."started_at")

investment_holding_transactions_kind_sha.name: investment_holding_transactions_kind_shape_check
investment_holding_transactions_kind_sha.value:
(
    ("investment_holding_transactions"."kind" IN ('opening', 'buy', 'sell') AND "investment_holding_transactions"."units_micros" > 0)
    OR ("investment_holding_transactions"."kind" = 'distribution' AND "investment_holding_transactions"."units_micros" = 0 AND "investment_holding_transactions"."amount_minor" > 0)
    OR ("investment_holding_transactions"."kind" = 'fee' AND "investment_holding_transactions"."units_micros" = 0 AND "investment_holding_transactions"."amount_minor" > 0 AND "investment_holding_transactions"."fee_minor" = 0)
  )

investment_projection_projects_mode_amou.name: investment_projection_projects_mode_amount_check
investment_projection_projects_mode_amou.value: ("investment_projection_projects"."mode" = 'calculator' AND "investment_projection_projects"."manual_starting_amount_minor" IS NOT NULL) OR ("investment_projection_projects"."mode" = 'portfolio' AND "investment_projection_projects"."manual_starting_amount_minor" IS NULL)

migration_issues_source_pair_check.name: migration_issues_source_pair_check
migration_issues_source_pair_check.value: ("migration_issues"."source_address" IS NULL OR "migration_issues"."sheet_name" IS NOT NULL) AND ("migration_issues"."record_id" IS NULL OR "migration_issues"."record_type" IS NOT NULL)

recurring_cash_flow_occurrence_exception.name: recurring_cash_flow_occurrence_exceptions_value_check
recurring_cash_flow_occurrence_exception.value: ("recurring_cash_flow_occurrence_exceptions"."kind" = 'skip' AND "recurring_cash_flow_occurrence_exceptions"."date_override" IS NULL AND "recurring_cash_flow_occurrence_exceptions"."amount_override_minor" IS NULL AND "recurring_cash_flow_occurrence_exceptions"."account_override_id" IS NULL AND "recurring_cash_flow_occurrence_exceptions"."from_account_override_id" IS NULL AND "recurring_cash_flow_occurrence_exceptions"."to_account_override_id" IS NULL AND "recurring_cash_flow_occurrence_exceptions"."status_override" IS NULL) OR ("recurring_cash_flow_occurrence_exceptions"."kind" = 'override' AND ("recurring_cash_flow_occurrence_exceptions"."date_override" IS NOT NULL OR "recurring_cash_flow_occurrence_exceptions"."amount_override_minor" IS NOT NULL OR "recurring_cash_flow_occurrence_exceptions"."account_override_id" IS NOT NULL OR "recurring_cash_flow_occurrence_exceptions"."from_account_override_id" IS NOT NULL OR "recurring_cash_flow_occurrence_exceptions"."to_account_override_id" IS NOT NULL OR "recurring_cash_flow_occurrence_exceptions"."status_override" IS NOT NULL))

recurring_cash_flow_occurrence_exception.name: recurring_cash_flow_occurrence_exceptions_transfer_endpoint_check
recurring_cash_flow_occurrence_exception.value: ("recurring_cash_flow_occurrence_exceptions"."from_account_override_id" IS NULL) = ("recurring_cash_flow_occurrence_exceptions"."to_account_override_id" IS NULL) OR ("recurring_cash_flow_occurrence_exceptions"."from_account_override_id" IS NOT NULL AND "recurring_cash_flow_occurrence_exceptions"."to_account_override_id" IS NOT NULL)

recurring_cash_flow_series_state_end_che.name: recurring_cash_flow_series_state_end_check
recurring_cash_flow_series_state_end_che.value: ("recurring_cash_flow_series"."state" = 'ended' AND "recurring_cash_flow_series"."ended_on" IS NOT NULL) OR ("recurring_cash_flow_series"."state" <> 'ended' AND "recurring_cash_flow_series"."ended_on" IS NULL)

recurring_transactions_transfer_endpoint.name: recurring_transactions_transfer_endpoint_check
recurring_transactions_transfer_endpoint.value: ("recurring_transactions"."kind" = 'transfer' AND "recurring_transactions"."account_id" IS NULL AND "recurring_transactions"."from_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "recurring_transactions"."to_account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "recurring_transactions"."from_account_id" <> "recurring_transactions"."to_account_id") OR ("recurring_transactions"."kind" <> 'transfer' AND "recurring_transactions"."from_account_id" IS NULL AND "recurring_transactions"."to_account_id" IS NULL)

salary_years_status_final_check.name: salary_years_status_final_check
salary_years_status_final_check.value: ("salary_years"."status" = 'finalized' AND "salary_years"."final_federal_minor" IS NOT NULL) OR ("salary_years"."status" = 'in_progress' AND "salary_years"."final_federal_minor" IS NULL)

transactions_recurring_scheduled_occurre.name: transactions_recurring_scheduled_occurrence_idx
transactions_recurring_scheduled_occurre.where: "transactions"."is_generated" = true AND "transactions"."recurring_series_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."scheduled_occurrence_on" IS NOT NULL

transactions_generated_identity_check.name: transactions_generated_identity_check
transactions_generated_identity_check.value: "transactions"."is_generated" = false OR ("transactions"."recurring_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."recurring_series_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."recurring_occurrence_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."scheduled_occurrence_on" IS NOT NULL)

transfers_recurring_scheduled_occurrence.name: transfers_recurring_scheduled_occurrence_idx
transfers_recurring_scheduled_occurrence.where: "transfers"."is_generated" = true AND "transfers"."recurring_series_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transfers"."scheduled_occurrence_on" IS NOT NULL

transfers_generated_identity_check.name: transfers_generated_identity_check
transfers_generated_identity_check.value: "transfers"."is_generated" = false OR ("transfers"."recurring_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transfers"."recurring_series_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transfers"."recurring_occurrence_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transfers"."scheduled_occurrence_on" IS NOT NULL)

users_display_name_format_check.name: users_display_name_format_check
users_display_name_format_check.value: "users"."display_name" IS NULL OR ("users"."display_name" = btrim("users"."display_name") AND char_length("users"."display_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 80)

users_demo_state_check.name: users_demo_state_check
users_demo_state_check.value: ("users"."is_demo" = false AND "users"."demo_fixture_version" IS NULL) OR ("users"."is_demo" = true AND "users"."demo_fixture_version" > 0)
